description: Cierre y Apertura de Puertos Nacionales is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Marina (SEMAR). Información estadística histórica sobre los cierres y aperturas de puertos, derivados de condiciones meteorológicas u otras causas operacionales, clasificadas por región y periodo. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Marina (SEMAR). Its tags are actividad marítima, asunto marítimo, infraestructura naval, infraestructura portuaria, ingeniería portuaria costera. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-04-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
